{{Top|leg}}
According to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]' writings, '''pneuma''' was the part of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that was the expression of conscious thought. It was one of the three aspects of the Force, along with the [[anima]] and the [[aperion]].

Thinking, self-aware minds contributed to the collective pneuma, and it could be accessed by naturally [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] species, as well as the various [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]] by both the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Behind the scenes==
This aspect (or category) of existence that draws on the Force was first mentioned in the ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', on page 130.
